description:
Container shipping schedule intelligence sourced from Weiyun's public APIs
(port catalog, carriers per port, fleet routes per carrier) plus per-lane
schedule data scraped from routePort URLs the user has registered.

The 4 public APIs at wywapi.weiyun001.com require no auth and return clean
JSON: port catalog, carrier list per port, service lines per (port,carrier),
and continent-grouped service maps. They cover lane discovery and prospecting.

Per-week schedule data (ETD dates, transit days, carrier services with
10-day-window sailings) comes from /routePort URLs the user captures once
in their browser; the CLI scrapes the HTML on demand. Both layers are
pure HTTP replay — no resident browser, no encryption reverse-engineering.

tools.name: carrier_services_list
tools.description: Continent → service map for a (port, carrier) pair. Required: portCode, carrierCode. Returns the new CarrierServicesResponse.

tools.name: carriers_by_port
tools.description: Carriers (船公司) that depart from the named port. Required: startPortCode. Returns the CarrierListResponse.

params.name: startPortCode
params.description: Weiyun port code, e.g. 'CNNSA' for Nansha. Use `ports` command for the catalog.

tools.name: fleet_routes_list
tools.description: Service lines (e.g. REX2, BEX, MEX) that a carrier runs out of the given port, grouped by destination region. Required: startPortCode, carrier. Returns the FleetRoutesResponse.

tools.name: ports_list
tools.description: Full list of ~200 ports Weiyun knows about (English/Chinese names, port code, pinyin). Returns the PortListResponse.
